name: JWT Auth Interceptor
description: Intercepts outgoing HTTP requests to a specific external service (configured via OMATE_REMOTE_SERVICE_URL) and injects an Authorization: Bearer header using OMATE_USER_TOKEN. Does NOT intercept LLM API calls.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 拦截发往指定外部服务（通过 OMATE_REMOTE_SERVICE_URL 配置）的 HTTP 请求，注入 Authorization: Bearer 认证头（值来自 OMATE_USER_TOKEN）。不拦截 LLM API 调用。
description_i18n.en-US: Intercepts outgoing HTTP requests to a specific external service (configured via OMATE_REMOTE_SERVICE_URL) and injects an Authorization: Bearer header using OMATE_USER_TOKEN. Does NOT intercept LLM API calls.

author: Qoder
